title: On the microstructure-dependency of mechanical properties and failure of low-pressure cold-sprayed tungsten carbide-nickel metal matrix composite coatings

preSprayedProperties.Majority_Powder_Source: Pacific Particulate Materials Ltd., Port Moody, BC, Canada

experimentalProperties.Spraying_System_Model: SST series P, CenterLine, Ltd., Windsor, ON, Canada

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: 6.35 ± 0.06 wt% WC in coating. distribution of the WC particles in the matrix was heterogeneous as they were non-uniformly distributed in the metal matrix. there was a total interfacial area per unit thickness of 5,586 ± 147 μm and an average reinforcing particle size of 19.37 ± 0.44 μm with a mean free path of 83 ± 10 μm.
